use.t: 标题分级：页面 > 模块 > 小节，层级一眼看清
长文正文：根据阅读场景设置清楚易读的字号和行高
辅助信息：时间、备注，用灰色小字弱化
强调重点：加粗或变色，只标真正关键的内容

dont.t: 标题样式过多：层级差异反而难以辨认
正文使用过浅的灰色和过小字号：文字对比度与可读性都会降低
整段加粗：各处权重相同，真正的重点难以辨认
用空格和换行模拟对齐：使用 {c:space} 统一管理

lessonPractice.title: 设置页的标题、说明和权限警告几乎一样大，警告还是很浅的灰色。应该怎样调整？

options.label: 建立清楚的标题、正文和警告层级，并保证警告可读
options.feedback: 不同文字承担不同责任；稳定的字号、字重和对比度能让用户先看到重点，又不会漏掉警告。

options.label: 把页面所有文字一起加粗，让每一段都更醒目
options.feedback: 所有内容权重相同后，标题和警告反而失去区别，用户仍然找不到阅读顺序。

options.label: 继续缩小说明和警告，只把页面标题放大
options.feedback: 标题会更突出，但必须阅读的警告仍然难以看清；弱化辅助信息不能牺牲可读性。

en.title: A settings page gives its heading, descriptions, and permission warning nearly the same size, while the warning is very light gray. What should change?

options.label: Define clear heading, body, and warning roles and keep the warning readable
options.feedback: Each text role has a different job. Consistent size, weight, and contrast reveal the reading order without hiding the warning.

options.label: Bold every piece of text so that every paragraph becomes more prominent
options.feedback: When everything has equal emphasis, headings and warnings lose distinction and the reading order remains unclear.

options.label: Make descriptions and warnings smaller and enlarge only the page title
options.feedback: The title becomes clearer, but required warning text remains difficult to read. Supporting text still needs sufficient legibility.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请整理设置页排版：明确页面标题、分组标题、正文和警告四种文字层级，警告不能用过小或过浅的字。不要把整页一起加粗。请在桌面和手机上确认阅读顺序清楚、重要信息可读。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Refine the settings typography with distinct page heading, section heading, body, and warning roles. Do not make warnings too small or light or bold the entire page. Verify a clear reading order and readable critical text on desktop and mobile.

use.t: Create clear levels for page, section, and item headings
